3º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 9

Can for ability

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Say what you can and can't do
  • Use can with all persons, always the same
  • Ask «Can you…?» and answer «Yes, I can / No, I can't»
  • Talk about the abilities of animals and robots

Para pensar

Un pájaro vuela, pero no sabe leer. Tú sabes leer, pero no vuelas. ¿Qué palabra mágica del inglés sirve para decir lo que cada uno sabe hacer?

Explicación

I can!

We use can to talk about abilities: things we are able to do. «I can run.» «I can sing.» «I can count to one hundred.» After can, we put the verb: can + run, can + swim.

En castellano: can significa «saber» o «poder»: «I can swim» = «sé nadar». Es uno de los verbos más útiles del inglés. Di en voz alta tres cosas que can hacer: «I can… I can… I can…!»

Action verbs

We need action verbs to talk about abilities: run (correr), jump (saltar), swim (nadar), fly (volar), climb (trepar), dance (bailar), sing (cantar), skip (saltar a la comba), ride a bike (montar en bici), play the piano, draw (dibujar) and cook (cocinar).

Play Action mime: one child mimes a verb and the class guesses: «You can swim!». Moverte te ayuda a recordar las palabras.

Can is the same for everybody

Can is very easy: it never changes. I can, you can, he can, she can, it can, we can, they can. We never add -s: «She can dance», not «she cans dance».

And the verb after can doesn't change either: «He can swim», not «he can swims» or «he can to swim». Truco: piensa que can es como un ayudante que siempre va igual vestido, con cualquier persona.

I can't

To say that we are not able to do something, we use can't (cannot): «I can't fly.» «My baby brother can't walk.» «Fish can't climb trees.»

We can join two sentences with but (pero): «I can swim, but I can't dive.» «Penguins can swim, but they can't fly.» Pronunciación: escucha bien la t final: can (sí) y can't (no) suenan parecido.

Can you…?

To ask about abilities, put Can first: «Can you ride a bike?», «Can your dog jump?», «Can they speak English?».

The short answers are: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.; Yes, it can. / No, it can't. En castellano: «¿Sabes montar en bici?» → «Can you ride a bike?». Solo cambias el orden: can va delante de la persona.

Animals can…

Animals have got amazing abilities. «Birds can fly.» «Fish can swim.» «Monkeys can climb trees.» «Kangaroos can jump very high.» «Parrots can talk.» «Cheetahs can run very fast.»

But they can't do everything: «Elephants can't jump.» «Snakes can't walk.» «Penguins can't fly.» Reto: piensa en tu animal favorito y di una cosa que can y otra que can't hacer.

Robots and superheroes

Let's imagine! A robot can do many things: «My robot can clean my room. It can carry heavy boxes. It can speak ten languages. But it can't swim: water is dangerous for robots!»

And a superhero? «Super Lola can fly and she can run faster than a car. She can see through walls. She can't cook!» Inventa tu propio robot o superhéroe y di tres cosas que can y una que can't.

Reading: the school talent show

Read the poster: «Talent Show on Friday! Come and see the stars of class 3A. Lucía can play the violin. Omar can do ten cartwheels (volteretas laterales). Iker and Ana can sing and dance. Mei can't sing, but she can draw a portrait in one minute! And our headteacher can juggle with three balls!»

Answer: What can Omar do? Can Mei sing? Who can play the violin?

Let's practise: Find someone who can…

Play Find someone who can… Your card says: whistle (silbar), touch your toes, count to 20 in English, stand on one foot, say the alphabet. Walk around and ask: «Can you whistle?» If the answer is «Yes, I can», they show you and you write their name.

At the end, tell the class: «Pablo can whistle. Sara can stand on one foot. Nobody can say the alphabet backwards!» ¡Gana quien complete la tarjeta antes!

Can for ability

Ejercicios

  1. Traduce: correr, saltar, trepar, volar.

  2. Completa: «Birds ___ fly.»

  3. Completa: «Fish ___ walk.» (no)

  4. Pregunta: «your sister / sing».

  5. Respuesta corta (sí): «Can you dance?»

  6. Respuesta corta (no): «Can it fly?»

  7. Une con but: «I can draw.» «I can't paint.»

  8. Corrige: «He can plays tennis.»

  9. Escribe una cosa que un pingüino can y otra que can't.

  10. Escribe tres cosas que sabes hacer.

Practica

  1. «Sé nadar» is…

    1. A) I swim can.
    2. B) I can swim.
    3. C) I cans swim.

  2. Birds ___ fly.

    1. A) can
    2. B) cans
    3. C) can to

  3. Elephants ___ jump.

    1. A) can
    2. B) cans
    3. C) can't

  4. She can ___.

    1. A) dances
    2. B) to dance
    3. C) dance

  5. «Can you skate?» — «Yes, …»

    1. A) I can.
    2. B) I do.
    3. C) I am.

  6. «Can it swim?» — «No, …»

    1. A) it isn't.
    2. B) it can't.
    3. C) it don't.

  7. «Trepar» is…

    1. A) climb
    2. B) jump
    3. C) fly

  8. ___ you ride a bike?

    1. A) Do
    2. B) Are
    3. C) Can

  9. I can sing, ___ I can't dance.

    1. A) and
    2. B) but
    3. C) or

  10. «Cannot» is the same as…

    1. A) can
    2. B) can't
    3. C) can not to

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: Para qué sirve can; Por qué can no cambia con ninguna persona; Cómo se dice lo que no sé hacer y cómo uno frases con but; Cómo pregunto Can you…? y respondo.

Resumen

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

canSaber / poder hacer algo.
can't (cannot)No saber / no poder.
Can you…?¿Sabes…? ¿Puedes…?
Yes, I can. / No, I can't.Respuestas cortas.
can + verboSin -s y sin to: she can swim.
butPero: I can run, but I can't fly.
climbTrepar.
ride a bikeMontar en bici.

Soluciones

  1. B) Can + verbo.
  2. A) Can.
  3. C) No pueden.
  4. C) Verbo sin -s.
  5. A) Yes, I can.
  6. B) It can't.
  7. A) Climb.
  8. C) Can delante.
  9. B) Contraste: but.
  10. B) Can't.

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. run, jump, climb, fly.
  2. can.
  3. can't.
  4. Can your sister sing?
  5. Yes, I can.
  6. No, it can't.
  7. I can draw, but I can't paint.
  8. He can play tennis.
  9. Penguins can swim, but they can't fly.
  10. Model answer: I can ride a bike. I can swim. I can play the guitar.
